text: げんだいに　なお　いき　のこる　ニンジャの　こわさを　みたな！

structure.jp: げんだいに　なお　いき　のこる　ニンジャの　こわさを
structure.en: the fearsomeness of the ninja who still survive in modern times

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: げんだいに　なお　いき　のこる　ニンジャ
patterns.explanation: The whole phrase before ニンジャ describes the ninja, like 'who' in English. げんだいに　なお　いき　のこる　ニンジャ = 'ninja who still survive in modern times'.

patterns.name: 〜な (confirming)
patterns.explanation: な at the end of a full sentence is a man's rough 'huh' or 'haven't you'. みたな = 'you've seen it, haven't you'.
